title: The “Premium” gate — remove it, or build behind it?
question: The squad page blocks a fourth tracked rival behind a Premium tier that does not exist. Remove it, or commit to monetising this season?
context: Raised by the CPO in the September audit. There is no Premium tier, no accounts system and nothing to buy, so a working feature is withheld for zero revenue in a product whose positioning is honesty. Removing it is roughly an hour and reversible.
